title: Superlatives
summary: Superlatives compare one thing to all others in a group: the biggest, the most interesting.

theory.markdown:
**Superlatives** express the highest degree in a group. Always use **the** before a superlative.

**Short adjectives** (1-2 syllables): add **-est**
*tall -> the tallest / big -> the biggest / easy -> the easiest*

**Long adjectives** (2+ syllables): use **the most**
*interesting -> the most interesting / expensive -> the most expensive*

**Spelling rules** (same as comparatives):
- CVC -> double consonant: *big -> the biggest*
- consonant + y -> -iest: *happy -> the happiest*

**Irregular forms:**
*good -> the best / bad -> the worst / far -> the furthest / little -> the least*

items.source: This is the longest river in the world.
items.translation: To jest najdluzsza rzeka na swiecie.

items.source: She is the most intelligent person I know.
items.translation: Ona jest najinteligentniejsza osoba, jaka znam.

items.source: That was the worst film I've ever seen.
items.translation: To byl najgorszy film, jaki kiedykolwiek widzialem.

exercises.prompt: This is ___ (tall) building in the city.
It was ___ (bad) day of my life.
She is ___ student in the class.

exercises.sentence: Mount Everest is most high mountain in the world.
answers: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
exercises.explanation: Short adjective 'high' -> the highest. Don't forget 'the'.

exercises.source: To jest najdrozszy hotel w miescie.
answers: This is the most expensive hotel in the city.
That is the most expensive hotel in the city.

exercises.prompt: January is ___ (cold) month of the year here.
Amazon is ___ river in the world by volume.
He is ___ (happy) person I've ever met.

exercises.sentence: This is the more expensive watch in the shop.
answers: This is the most expensive watch in the shop.
exercises.explanation: Long adjective 'expensive' -> the most expensive (not 'the more').

exercises.source: To jest najlepszy dzien w moim zyciu!
answers: This is the best day of my life!
That is the best day of my life!

options: She is the most young in the family.
She is the youngest in the family.
She is youngest in the family.
She is the more young in the family.
exercises.explanation: Short adjective 'young' -> the youngest. Always use 'the'.

exercises.prompt: This is ___ (interesting) book I have ever read.

exercises.sentence: He ran the most fast of all the runners.
answers: He ran the fastest of all the runners.
exercises.explanation: 'Fast' is a short adjective -> the fastest (not 'the most fast').

exercises.source: To jest najkrotsza droga do stacji.
answers: This is the shortest way to the station.
This is the shortest route to the station.
That is the shortest way to the station.
